title: Quarterly roadmap synthesis: cohort-aligned sprint heuristics for Hosted API + Model Catalog
creator: Aisha Patel
project: Hosted API + Model Catalog Cohort Alignment
description: Synthesize stakeholder inputs across GTM, Platform, and Eng to produce a quarter-level roadmap that maps cohort-based sprint heuristics to OKRs, release windows, and fallback policies for the Hosted API and Model Catalog. Deliverable: a staged roadmap (commit windows, canary lanes, contingency triggers) and a lightweight playbook for program managers to operationalize rotations and capacity hedges.
acceptance_criteria: Roadmap doc with cohort lanes (PLG, Enterprise, Platform) published in Confluence
Clear commit windows and canary schedules aligned to Dedicated capacity forecasts
OKR mapping: each roadmap item linked to at least one objective and measurable key result
Playbook with rollback/fallback policy templates and owner assignments
Stakeholder sign-off from Platform Eng, Sales Ops, and Security
work_updates: 2026-02-12 — Kickoff with Platform Eng and Solutions: clarified definition of cohorts (PLG, Mid-Market, Enterprise) and surfaced capacity signals needed for commit windows.
2026-02-18 — Drafted cohort lane matrix in Confluence (link below). Asked Eng to provide 90/95/99th percentile latency targets per lane for capacity sims.
2026-02-25 — Eng provided throughput forecasts and canary cadence recommendations. Decision: prefer staggered canaries per cohort (PLG fast cadence, Enterprise slower with longer monitoring window).
2026-03-02 — PM review with Sales Ops: added enterprise migration window constraints and expanded rollback playbook to include customer communication templates.
2026-03-09 — Added contingency hedge: reserve 10% Dedicated burst capacity for the first two weeks of major lineup changes; created follow-up ticket for capacity billing impact analysis.
2026-03-10 — Prep for leadership review this week. Ready version v0.3 of the roadmap and playbook for exec feedback.
decision_log: Use cohort lanes as primary axis for scheduling model rotations and canaries to reduce cross-customer blast radius.
Adopt two-tier commit windows: fast (PLG, 1-week canary) and guarded (Enterprise, 3-week canary) with automatic rollback triggers on error-rate > 1.5x baseline.
Quantization/variant swaps will be gated behind a quality smoke test suite and 100-sample eval tied to regression alerts.
risks: Capacity mismatch between expected PLG burst and Dedicated reservation could increase unit costs.
Insufficient telemetry for early detection of model quality regressions in Enterprise canary windows.
Cross-team alignment drift: GTM timeline changes could force mid-cycle roadmap shifts.
mitigations: Run capacity stress sims using historical PLG traffic + 25% synthetic surge and validate cost delta before committing to reservations.
Instrument additional end-to-end eval hooks (prompt sets) for canaries and tie alerts to on-call rotations for the duration of the canary.
Lock a single owner per cohort lane for decision authority and schedule weekly syncs through the commit window.
next_steps: Finalize v0.3 Confluence draft and circulate to execs (Platform Eng, SRE, Sales Ops) — due 2026-03-12.
Open follow-up tickets: capacity billing impact analysis (PM-421358), canary telemetry gaps (ENG-73221), customer comms template (DES-9921).
Schedule cross-functional tabletop for rollback rehearsals during the first week of April.
